sn20.10:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulesu cārittam āpajjati ||
sn20.10:1.5: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno na viramati || || 4
sn20.10:1.6: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || pe|| Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || || 5
sn20.10:1.7: Idha bhante aññataro bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulesu cārittam āpajjati ||
sn20.10:2.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave biḷāro sandhisamalasaṅkaṭīre ṭhito ahosi mudumūsiṃ maggayamāno || ||
sn20.10:2.2: Yadāyam mudumūsī gocarāya pakkamissati tattheva naṃ gahetvā khādissāmīti || || 7
sn20.10:2.3: Atha kho so bhikkhave mudumūsī gocarāya pakkami ||
sn20.10:2.4: tam enaṃ biḷāro gahetvā sahasā saṃkharitvā ajjhohari || ||
sn20.10:2.5: Tassa mudumūsī antam pi khādi antaguṇam pi khādi ||
sn20.10:2.6: so tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ pi nigacchati maraṇamattam pi dukkhaṃ || || 8
sn20.10:3.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya gāmaṃ va nigamam va piṇḍāya pavisati arakkhiteneva kāyena arakkhitāya vācāya arakkhitena cittena anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā asaṃvutehi indriyehi || || 9
sn20.10:3.2: So tattha passati mātugāmaṃ dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā ||
sn20.10:3.3: tassa mātugāmaṃ disvā dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti ||
sn20.10:3.4: so rāgānuddhaṃsena cittena maraṇaṃ vā nigacchati maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ || || 10
sn20.10:3.5: Maraṇañhetam bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yo sikkham paccakkhāya hināyāvattati ||
sn20.10:3.6: maraṇamattañhetaṃ bhikkhave dukkhaṃ yadidam aññataraṃ saṅkiliṭṭham āpattim āpajjati ||
sn20.10:3.9: Rakkhiteneva kāyena rakkhitāya vācāya rakkhitena cittena upaṭṭhitāya satiyā saṃvutehi indriyehi gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisissāmāti || ||
